utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the fourth. Everyone on? I've got a frozen picture but I can hear you.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here. The heating in the portakabin's still making it feel like August. Lovely in June, that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Better than outside. Whose new car is that in the car park, then? Taking up rather a lot of space.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one held together by road dirt.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And the broken coffee machine in the canteen means we're doing this without proper coffee. Just moaning, not putting it on the maintenance list.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Good, because I'm not qualified to deal with that level of emergency.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, um, completed stuff first. Then what we're actually agreeing.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the WHB on Tuesday. That's finished, nothing carrying over from it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And we finished the repair on the turbine one compressor last night. That's closed on the plan now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Both done, neither needs another job raising.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the 11kV board, nothing we can do until they arrive. No progress to report there.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Still blocked, not something we're picking up today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same story for access: can't get to the line 1 TCU until production gives us a window. We haven't got that window.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's staying blocked, then. Not in today's available work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Also, the shutdown on the palletiser is cancelled now, production need it running. That shutdown's off.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, the planned shutdown. Not permission to run through a fault, obviously.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: While we're there, I noticed the Palletiser was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Just an observation, not asking for a temperature job.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, so the jam on the Palletiser is separate from that. That's the live issue, not the warmth.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. What's the position with that jam, then?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the Palletiser by 11am. Normal priority. That's a local fault intervention, not bringing the cancelled shutdown back.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Olu for the Palletiser, by 11am, normal priority. Got you.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine. Safe isolation for the jam, obviously.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that's understood. I was talking about the longer shutdown, not skipping isolation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz Nowak, can you grease and check the bearings on the turbine two for Monday?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grease and check the bearings on the turbine two for Monday. I can take that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Grease and condition check, rather than a strip-down?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's it. Grease and check the bearings. Not agreeing a strip-down here.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Monday against Tomasz Nowak. Fine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, water side next. There are two separate things here, so don't roll them into one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll take vibration readings on the water booster by 11am. Low priority, but I'll have the readings done by then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sarah for the water booster readings. That's not you taking the pressure-drop investigation as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, just the vibration readings. Keep the pressure-drop investigation separate.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, the pressure drop on the Water Booster Pump still needs investigating. The readings aren't a substitute for that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We need someone to investigate the pressure drop on the Water Booster Pump after lunch. Drop everything for that one. Who can actually take it?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, I can't commit to that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Not me either. I can't accept it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take ownership of that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'm flagging it, but I'm not taking it on. Don't put my name against it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No taker from me either, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Then it's unallocated. After lunch, drop everything for that one, but no owner.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. It's still needed and still that urgent. Nobody's accepted it; we're not pretending it's covered.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Separately, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve after lunch. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Okay, Saz on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve sensors. Calibration, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, recalibrate the sensors. That's the job I'm taking after lunch.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, not a mechanical valve overhaul. Different scope.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got it: Saz, sensor recalibration after lunch. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: While we're on the less dramatic stuff, I'll sort the training records for the new starters by end of day. No rush.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, PR. Training records with you, by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep. No rush, but I am taking it, not just mentioning the pile.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Paperwork doesn't make much noise, does it? Still manages to fill a stand-up.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Usually just me sighing at it, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll run the monthly fire alarm test by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sarah for the monthly fire alarm test, by the 28th. That's this month's one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, June's monthly test. Mine.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, so I'll book a contractor to look at the CV01 by the end of the week. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—booking by the end of the week, not promising they'll actually be here by then?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll get the contractor booked to look at the CV01 by the end of the week. That's the commitment, not a visit date.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Cal owns the booking. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. No contractor attendance date being agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. That's clear. Anything we've accidentally made sound available when it isn't?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Only to underline the 11kV board is still parts-blocked. Nothing changed during this call.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, stays blocked. No new action on that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And line 1 TCU still has no production window. Same position as before.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: The uncovered one is the Water Booster Pump pressure drop. It's still nobody against that, despite the after-lunch urgency.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. Nobody assigned, nobody volunteered. Keep that visible as unallocated, not agreed to me alongside the readings.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. And the coffee machine remains a source of emotional damage only.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Cheers, everyone. That's us.
